description: Collection-backed readiness view for market, SEC, and FRED inputs. This dashboard never substitutes synthetic market observations when Parquet is empty.

panels.description: A source is ready only after a successful collection. Actual normalized observations remain in Parquet and are queried through DuckDB/Jupyter.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::double precision AS value FROM data_sources ds WHERE ds.enabled AND ds.code IN ('prices', 'marketdata', 'sec', 'fred') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ingestion_runs ir WHERE ir.data_source_id = ds.id AND ir.status = 'succeeded')

panels.title: Ready vertical-slice sources

panels.description: Last successful publication by source. Empty means that collector has not completed successfully.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ds.code AS source, ds.name, max(ir.finished_at) FILTER (WHERE ir.status = 'succeeded') AS last_success, coalesce(sum(ir.records_written) FILTER (WHERE ir.status = 'succeeded' AND ir.finished_at >= now() - interval '30 days'), 0) AS records_written_30d FROM data_sources ds LEFT JOIN ingestion_runs ir ON ir.data_source_id = ds.id WHERE ds.code IN ('prices', 'marketdata', 'sec', 'fred') OR ds.source_kind::text IN ('market_data', 'filings', 'macro') GROUP BY ds.code, ds.name ORDER BY ds.code

panels.title: Market-data input readiness (no synthetic fallback)

panels.description: Collector output volume is metadata, not a price or economic value.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ir.finished_at, '1d'), ds.code AS metric, sum(ir.records_written)::double precision AS value FROM ingestion_runs ir JOIN data_sources ds ON ds.id = ir.data_source_id WHERE $__timeFilter(ir.finished_at) AND ir.status = 'succeeded' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
